Responsible_Organization: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare / NIC
Variables_Covered: State, District, Market, Commodity, Variety, Grade, Arrival_Date, Min_Price, Max_Price, Modal_Price
Date_Range_and_Frequency: Daily updates; historical archives from 2000 to present
Join_Keys_to_Existing_Data: State + District + Market + Commodity + Variety + Grade + Arrival_Date
Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Government Open Data License - India (GODL); free API key required
Publication_Delay_and_Timing: T+0 to T+1 (reported evening of trading day)
Limitations_and_Data_Quality_Notes: Arrival quantities are strictly ABSENT in this core price endpoint; missingness during holidays/closures; market name spelling changes (e.g., APMC suffix).

Responsible_Organization: Centre for Economic Data and Analysis (CEDA), Ashoka University
Download_Status: Verified Accessible via REST API (Swagger UI /v1)
Variables_Covered: Modal_Price, Min_Price, Max_Price, Quantity Arrivals (Tonnes / Quintals)
Geographic_Coverage: 2,700+ Mandis across India (all UP districts, 300+ commodities)
Date_Range_and_Frequency: 2000 to present; Daily records and monthly aggregates
Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Free academic and non-commercial research use; user registration required; attribution to CEDA Ashoka required
Publication_Delay_and_Timing: T+1 to T+7 depending on state Agmarknet upload synchronisation
Limitations_and_Data_Quality_Notes: Arrivals data can have reporting gaps; units require standardisation (tonnes vs quintals); requires resolving nominal market name aliases.

Responsible_Organization: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences
Variables_Covered: Daily Rainfall (mm/day) on 0.25 x 0.25 degree grid (135 x 129 matrix)
Date_Range_and_Frequency: 1901 to 2024; Daily time series (split by annual NetCDF files)
Resolution: 0.25 x 0.25 degree spatial grid (~27.5 km x 27.5 km)
Join_Keys_to_Existing_Data: Mandi coordinate centroid (nearest grid point) + Date
Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Government of India data policy; academic research use permitted; commercial use requires clearance
Publication_Delay_and_Timing: Annual batch release latency; NOT available for real-time daily inference (best for historical retrospective backtests)
Limitations_and_Data_Quality_Notes: NetCDF raster format requires spatial slicing via xarray/netCDF4; spatial averaging over ~27 km cell averages microclimatic local convective bursts.

Source_Name: UPAg (Unified Portal for Agricultural Statistics) API
Variables_Covered: Area, Production, Yield (APY), Advance Crop Estimates, Primary Estimates
Date_Range_and_Frequency: Seasonal and Annual series; historical multi-year series
Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Restricted access; requires registered organizational userid and password authentication via OAuth2
Publication_Delay_and_Timing: Annual/seasonal publication lag (6 to 12 months after harvest)
Limitations_and_Data_Quality_Notes: Annual frequency is too coarse for daily T+7 market condition prediction; restricted authentication prevents open automated script ingestion.

Variables_Covered: T2M (Mean Temp), T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN, PRECTOTCORR (Precipitation), RH2M (Relative Humidity), WS10M (Wind Speed)
Geographic_Coverage: Global 0.5 x 0.5 degree grid (covers all UP mandis)
Resolution: Point latitude-longitude or regional bounding box
Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Public domain / NASA Open Science Policy; no API key required; rate-limited to 20 parameters/query
Publication_Delay_and_Timing: 2 to 4 days latency for final MERRA-2 assimilation; near-real-time preliminary available
Limitations_and_Data_Quality_Notes: Grid cell resolution (~50 km) averages microclimatic local rainfall bursts; point estimates interpolate gridded reanalysis.

Variables_Covered: State, District, Market, Commodity, Variety, Grade, Arrival_Date, Min_Price, Max_Price, Modal_Price

Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Government Open Data License - India (GODL); free API key required

Access_Restrictions_and_Licensing: Published research report; public PDF download

Publication_Delay_and_Timing: Fixed benchmark study; not a time series
Limitations_and_Data_Quality_Notes: National averages do not capture local UP farmgate conditions or seasonal weather shocks; illustrative research reference only.

Responsible_Organization: Central Warehousing Corporation, Department of Food & Public Distribution
